summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized valid/invalid test, a non-node input test, and a graph-unchanged test. The 40 tests in the new module and test/test_path.py pass under the prepared venv. Nothing was committed and no existing files were changed. Not verified: mypy, black, isort, and flake8 are not installed in the venv, so type-check and formatting were checked only by hand (no lines over 88 columns).
